text:
Situation: Vecuronium bromide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-05-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 78 months. Corvale East holds 11 days of supply and Corvale General holds 18 days at current usage rates across multiple presentations and lot counts.

Why (FDA record): FDA posted the shortage on 2020-05-06. An inspection of Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited, a registered plant on a vecuronium bromide label for analysis, manufacture, and pack, ended 2019-12-13 and was classified OAI with eight observations including absence of written procedures and control procedures to monitor and validate performance, 145 days before the shortage posting. Subsequent FDA inspections of Eugia on 2024-02-02 and 2026-02-06 were also classified OAI, and a Warning Letter was issued 2024-08-15.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations beyond two to three weeks. A pharmacist-approved therapeutic interchange to the same product from Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083013910) was authorized on 2026-01-27. Mylan Institutional LLC is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses MYLAN LABS LTD.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute purchase from Mylan Institutional LLC — requires buyer approval.
2. Activate the Gland Pharma Limited interchange (NDC 68083013910) for all presentations — requires pharmacist approval.
3. Qualify HF Acquisition Co LLC (HealthFirst), Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. as backup sources — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delay procurement pending further FDA updates; rely solely on existing Eugia-linked supply given repeated OAI classifications.
